[LIMP.4.2.4] **Each name in the selective-import list is a
single identifier.** Dotted forms (`from ha import
light.turn_on`) are compile errors. The importable
identifiers are the principal names declared at the
library's top level — schemas, consts, rules, flat-named
services, and **domains**. A domain is the first-segment
identifier of any dotted-name service declaration in the
library; importing the domain brings the whole `<domain>.*`
service set into bare scope.
